author: David Bombal
description:
Apple now requires UK users to confirm they’re adults before changing certain safety settings. David asks what this means for privacy, ownership and where age verification goes next.

Apple says UK adults may need to confirm they are 18+ using methods including a credit card or ID before disabling certain safety features. Apple also says users who don't verify can continue using their device, although some settings and 18+ app downloads remain restricted. Apple Support

Big Brother Watch argues that Apple's OS-level implementation goes beyond what UK law actually requires. Big Brother Watch

title: Do You Really Own Your iPhone?
